name: labs/pymodaq__pymodaq_plugins_thorlabs
title: Thorlabs Kinesis brushless DC motor controller channel
intro: Thorlabs Kinesis brushless DC motor controller channel, adapted from pymodaq/pymodaq_plugins_thorlabs. It reads `position`, `target_position`, `units`, `homed` and 1 more; runs `move_abs`, `move_rel`, `home` and `stop_motion`. `move_abs`: move the bound Kinesis channel to an absolute target with the controller's native MoveTo. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
